messages:
nora (design): quick follow-up from the design critique: compact routing editor preview has three small UX/accessibility annoyances we should fix before the demo. looping @ishaan @carmen
ishaan (pm): list them out with repro and any suggested copy please
nora (design): repro: Policy > Rules > open Preview > compact mode on > add 5 rules > narrow to 460px > reorder a rule > run sim. Issues: 1) SR only says 'list updated' on reorder, 2) validation chip is hover-only and disappears on small widths, 3) preview summary toast not announced and not keyboard reachable
carmen (frontend): can repro. root cause: we remount the preview on updates which unmounts live regions and kills focus. also the chip is absolutely positioned and only has a title tooltip. quick wins: keep a singleton sr-live outside the preview, make the chip a focusable control with aria-describedby, and avoid full unmounts
ras (eng): implementation plan: 1) srAnnouncer singleton with assertive for immediate moves and polite for end-of-sim summaries, 2) debounce move events to 180ms to avoid announcement floods but never suppress final summary, 3) ensure summary uses role=status and tabindex=0 so keyboard users can reach it
ora (design): copy recs (short): move -> 'Moved "{rule}" to position {n}'; conflict short -> 'Priority conflict 1 unreachable' (aria: 'Priority conflict, rule unreachable'); summary -> 'Simulation complete 1 {matched} matched, {fallback} fallback'
ishaan (pm): small question: should move message include routing target like model name? e.g., 'Moved X to pos 1 1 routes to model-a'
ras (eng): prefer short by default. we can add a verbose mode in settings for power users that includes model names and counts
carmen (frontend): UI details: make drag handle first in tab order with aria-label='Drag to reorder', add role=button and aria-grabbed during drag. change chip min-width and allow wrap to prevent overlap at <560px. bump chip contrast to meet WCAG AA for small text (>=4.5:1)
qa-robot: accessibility scan: failures detected: 1) .rule-chip contrast 2.6:1 -> recommend purple-80 + #fff or outline, 2) live region remounted on update, 3) drag handle missing aria-label and role
nora (design): one last UX ask: add a tiny 'How this sounds' toggle inside the Preview panel that reveals the last SR announcement text (short/verbose). writers can iterate copy without assistive tech. can be behind a flag if needed
ishaan (pm): good idea. add to ticket INF-4010. i'll create tickets: INF-4007 sr-announcer + debounce + visible-preview, INF-4008 chip keyboard + contrast + copy, INF-4009 preserve-focus-and-dom-reuse. target PRs by EOW. assign owners. thanks team :rocket:
